tools.name: lookup_attestation_by_tx

tools.name: get_attestation_by_round

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "verify_xrp_payment" is 604 chars, far longer than this server's median (111). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "verify_xrp_payment" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
